q: Parking Lot 基础需求包含哪些能力？（多选）
options: 支持 Motorcycle、Car、Large Vehicle 三类车
入场时自动分配兼容车位并发 ticket
出场时用 ticketId 校验、计费、释放车位
支付处理、摄像头、预约和 UI
why: 基础系统只覆盖入场分配、票据、出场计费和释放车位；支付、摄像头、预约在需求澄清阶段被明确划为范围外。
why_en: The base parking lot handles compatible spot assignment, ticket issuance, ticket-based exit, and fee calculation, while payment, cameras, and reservations stay out of scope.
options_en: Support three vehicle types: motorcycle, car, and large vehicle.
Automatically assign a compatible spot and issue a ticket on entry.
Validate the ticket ID, charge a fee, and free the spot on exit.
Payment processing, cameras, reservations, and UI.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在入场时生成的停车会话凭证，出场时用它校验和计费。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A ticket is the record the system creates at entry to represent one active parking session.

scenario: 系统只需要知道车辆是 motorcycle、car 还是 large 来匹配车位，不追踪车主、车牌或车辆状态。
q: Vehicle（车辆）在 Parking Lot 设计中应如何建模？
options: VehicleType enum，而不是 Vehicle 类
完整 Vehicle 类，含车牌、车主、保险字段
把 Vehicle 定义为 Ticket 的父类
把 Vehicle 定义为 ParkingSpot 的子类
why: 车辆是外部对象，系统不追踪它的状态，只需要一个分类标签匹配车位类型；建成类会引入系统不需要管理的状态。
why_en: Vehicle stays a type enum because the lot only needs the vehicle category for spot compatibility, not an entity with tracked state.
whenOtherWins: 如果需求加入车牌识别、黑名单、常客账户或车辆历史，Vehicle 才可能成为实体。
tradeoff: 轻量分类枚举 vs 承载状态的完整实体
options_en: A VehicleType enum instead of a Vehicle class.
A full Vehicle class with license plate, owner, and insurance fields.
Define Vehicle as a parent class of Ticket.
Define Vehicle as a subclass of ParkingSpot.

termDefinitions.meaning: 枚举类型，用一组预定义的常量表示分类，例如车辆类型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An enum is a fixed set of named constant values used to represent a category, like a vehicle type.

q: 最终设计中的核心实体/分类有哪些？（多选）
options: ParkingLot（编排者，管理索引与流程）
ParkingSpot（物理车位数据）
Ticket（停车会话记录）
Vehicle 完整类（车主、保险等状态）
why: ParkingLot 编排，ParkingSpot 存物理属性，Ticket 记会话；Vehicle 只是外部分类标签，没有被建成类。
why_en: The model centers on ParkingLot, ParkingSpot, and Ticket as classes, while Vehicle stays a classification label rather than a class.
options_en: ParkingLot: the orchestrator that manages indexes and the workflow.
ParkingSpot: physical spot data.
Ticket: the record of one parking session.
A full Vehicle class holding owner and insurance state.
diagram:
classDiagram
  class ParkingLot
  class ParkingSpot
  class Ticket
  ParkingLot --> ParkingSpot
  ParkingLot --> Ticket
  Ticket --> ParkingSpot : spotId

termDefinitions.meaning: 负责协调多个对象、驱动主流程的组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An orchestrator is the component that coordinates other objects and drives the main workflow.

scenario: 车辆入场时 ticket 一生成，该 spot 就被分配，即使车还没物理开到车位。
q: 本设计选择如何表示 occupied（占用）状态？
options: ParkingSpot 自己保存 occupied boolean
ParkingLot 维护 occupiedSpotIds Set 索引
完全从 activeTickets 每次动态推导
Ticket 自己负责释放车位
why: 占用被视为系统管理的 assignment 关系而非车位固有属性，由 ParkingLot 维护索引；Set 是受控冗余，换来 O(1) 查找和清晰的加锁边界。
why_en: ParkingLot tracks occupancy as an assignment relationship through an occupiedSpotIds Set, trading small redundancy for O(1) lookups and a clean locking boundary.
whenOtherWins: 如果更强调物理车位状态，ParkingSpot.occupied 也可行；Amazon Locker 就用了实体持有物理占用状态的方案。
tradeoff: 受控冗余换 O(1) 查找和并发边界 vs 零冗余但重复计算
options_en: ParkingSpot stores its own occupied boolean.
ParkingLot maintains an occupiedSpotIds Set as an index.
Derive occupancy from activeTickets on every lookup.
The Ticket itself frees the spot.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只存储唯一元素、支持快速成员判断的数据结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Set stores unique elements and supports a fast membership check.

termDefinitions.meaning: 操作耗时不随数据规模增长，例如 Set 的成员判断。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(1) means an operation's cost does not grow with the size of the input, like a Set membership check.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一份信息在多处保存，需要额外维护同步，换取查询速度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Denormalization keeps the same information in more than one place, trading extra sync work for faster reads.

q: Parking Lot 和 Amazon Locker 在占用状态建模上的核心差异是什么？
options: 两者都把占用看作车辆/包裹的物理存在状态
Parking Lot 和 Locker 都用同一个 Set 在编排者里维护占用
两者占用状态都由 Ticket/Token 自己持有并释放
Parking Lot 占用=ticket 分配关系，Locker 占用=物理包裹存在
why: 车位被分配给 ticket 是关系状态，包裹是否在格口是物理状态；这个语义差异解释了两套系统不同的占用建模。
why_en: Parking occupancy is assignment-like since a ticket references a spot, while locker occupancy is physical package presence, which explains the different modeling choices.
tradeoff: 关系型占用（assignment） vs 物理型占用（presence）
options_en: Both systems treat occupancy as the physical presence of a vehicle or package.
Both parking lot and locker maintain occupancy with the same Set on the orchestrator.
In both systems the ticket or token itself holds and releases the state.
Parking lot occupancy is a ticket-assignment relationship; locker occupancy is physical package presence.

termDefinitions.meaning: Amazon Locker 里用来验证取件人身份的一次性凭证。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A token is the one-time credential Amazon Locker uses to verify who may open a compartment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个电影订票系统案例，这里用来类比座位预订的占用关系。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BookMyShow is a movie-ticket booking case used here to compare seat-reservation occupancy.

scenario: 系统不维护 occupiedSpotIds 索引，而是每次入场都从 activeTickets 动态计算哪些 spot 被占用。
q: 完全从 activeTickets 推导 occupiedSpotIds 的优点和缺点是什么？
options: 推导后无法知道 ticket 对应哪个 spot
推导版本反而比维护 Set 更快，且没有任何代价
推导会自动避免所有并发 race
最少冗余，但每次分配要扫描 tickets，且并发时要锁整个 map
why: 推导状态概念上干净、没有冗余，但每次分配都要重复扫描 tickets，并发时还要锁住整个 activeTickets map；维护 Set 是受控冗余，换来清晰边界。
why_en: Deriving occupancy avoids redundancy but repeats the scan on every allocation and forces locking the whole ticket map under concurrency.
tradeoff: 零冗余的动态推导 vs 受控冗余的维护索引
options_en: Deriving occupancy makes it impossible to know which spot a ticket maps to.
The derived version is strictly faster than a maintained Set and has no downside.
Deriving occupancy automatically prevents all race conditions.
It has the least redundancy, but allocation must scan tickets and concurrent access needs to lock the whole map.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多线程同时读写共享状态，导致结果依赖执行顺序的错误。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A race condition happens when concurrent threads read and write shared state and the outcome depends on timing.

q: 补全状态归属心法：
text: 判断状态属于实体还是 orchestrator，可问它是实体的{{内在属性}}，还是系统管理的{{关系/分配}}。
why: 车位大小是内在属性，当前被哪个 ticket 占用是关系状态；这个判断能解释很多 LLD 设计里的状态归属取舍。
why_en: State ownership depends on whether the state is intrinsic to an entity or a relationship the system manages.

termDefinitions.meaning: 实体本身固有、不依赖外部关系的属性，比如车位的大小。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An intrinsic property belongs to the entity itself and does not depend on an external relationship, like a spot's size.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由系统在多个对象之间维护的关系，比如车位当前分配给哪张 ticket。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Relational state is a relationship the system maintains between objects, like which ticket a spot is currently assigned to.

scenario: 入场成功后，系统要在出场时识别停车会话、车位、车型和入场时间。
q: Ticket 应保存哪些核心字段？
options: id、spotId、vehicleType、entryTime
完整 ParkingSpot 引用、支付卡号、摄像头图片
只保存 vehicleType，其余现查
只保存 hourlyRate，不存时间
why: Ticket 是一次停车会话的不可变记录，出场计费和释放车位都依赖这四个字段，不多不少。
why_en: Ticket records the parking session with an ID, spot ID, vehicle type, and entry time, which is exactly what exit needs.
whenOtherWins: 如果要支持车牌识别或黑名单，需要新增专门实体，而不是把这些字段塞进 Ticket。
tradeoff: 只存最小必要字段 vs 塞进冗余引用和无关数据
options_en: id, spotId, vehicleType, and entryTime.
A full ParkingSpot reference, a payment card number, and a camera image.
Only vehicleType, looking everything else up later.
Only hourlyRate, without any timestamp.
diagram:
classDiagram
  class Ticket
  class Vehicle
  class ParkingSpot
  Ticket --> Vehicle
  Ticket --> ParkingSpot
  Ticket : spotId
  Ticket : entryTime

termDefinitions.meaning: 直接持有另一个对象的指针，可以调用它的方法或修改它的状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An object reference directly points to another object, letting you call its methods or change its state.

scenario: Ticket 需要在出场时告诉 ParkingLot 释放哪个车位，但不应该直接操作 ParkingSpot 对象。
q: Ticket 为什么存 spotId 字符串，而不是 ParkingSpot 对象引用？
options: ParkingSpot 不能有 id 字段
Ticket 是记录，存 ID 更简单，避免它导航或修改 Spot
spotId 字符串无法用来释放车位
Ticket 必须自己负责定价计算
why: Ticket 不应该伸手修改领域对象。ParkingLot 用 spotId 更新 occupiedSpotIds 即可，符合 Law of Demeter。
why_en: Ticket stores a spot ID to remain a simple record rather than a navigational object that reaches into ParkingSpot.
tradeoff: 存 ID 的简单记录 vs 存对象引用带来的导航能力
options_en: ParkingSpot is not allowed to have an id field.
Ticket is a record, and storing an ID is simpler and keeps it from navigating into or mutating Spot.
A spotId string cannot be used to free the spot.
Ticket must own the fee-calculation logic itself.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对象只应该跟直接协作者通信，不应该链式访问别的对象内部结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Law of Demeter says an object should only talk to its immediate collaborators, not reach through them into other objects.

scenario: 需求只有一条定价规则：所有车型同一 hourly rate，按小时向上取整。
q: 计费逻辑应放在哪个类里？
options: Ticket.calculateFee，并让 Ticket 自己保存 rate
ParkingLot.computeFee
ParkingSpot.getSpotType 顺带算价
VehicleType enum 内部计算
why: 计费是停车场业务政策，不是 ticket 记录本身的职责；简单需求下放在 ParkingLot 足够，也符合单一职责。
why_en: Fee calculation is a parking lot business policy, not behavior of the ticket record, so it belongs on ParkingLot.
whenOtherWins: 如果要支持多种复杂定价模型，可抽 PricingStrategy，而不是一开始就过度设计。
tradeoff: 定价放在业务编排者 vs 定价放在数据记录里
options_en: Ticket.calculateFee, with the ticket storing its own rate.
ParkingLot.computeFee.
ParkingSpot.getSpotType, computing price on the side.
Inside the VehicleType enum.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个类应该只有一个改变的理由。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Single Responsibility Principle says a class should have only one reason to change.

scenario: 系统要把 $5.47 这样的金额存成整数，并按小时向上取整计费。
q: 补全计费锚点：
text: 金额应以最小货币单位如 {{cents}} 的整数保存；时长按小时计费并 {{向上取整}}，所以 5 分钟也算 1 小时。
why: 金额用 cents 整数存储避免浮点误差（$5.47→547 cents）；时长向上取整这条规则直接决定 computeFee 的返回值。
why_en: Money is stored as integer cents to avoid floating-point error, and duration rounds up to whole hours, which directly drives computeFee's output.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用整数分表示金额，避免浮点小数误差累积。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Storing money as integer cents avoids the rounding errors that accumulate with floating-point fractions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不足一个整小时也按一整小时计费。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rounding up means any partial hour is still billed as a full hour.

scenario: 出场 API 收到 ticketId，需要快速验证票据并找到 entryTime 和 spotId。
q: activeTickets 应该用什么结构存储？
options: List<Ticket>，每次线性扫描是唯一选择
Map<String, Ticket>，以 ticketId 为 key
Set<ParkingSpot>，按车位去重
单个 currentTicket 字段
why: map 让『按 ticketId 查票』的意图显式化；200 张票时 benchmark 显示 map 0.12μs、list 扫描 1.93μs，但这个差距在停车场规模下不重要，map 的价值主要在代码可读性。
why_en: A map makes lookup-by-ticket-ID explicit, and even though it benchmarks faster than a list scan, the real win at parking-lot scale is code clarity.
whenOtherWins: 极小系统用 list 扫描也能工作，但没有 map 语义清楚。
tradeoff: 查找语义清晰的 Map vs 实现简单但要线性扫描的 List
options_en: List<Ticket>, where a linear scan is the only option.
Map<String, Ticket>, keyed by ticket ID.
Set<ParkingSpot>, deduplicated by spot.
A single currentTicket field.

termDefinitions.meaning: 键值对集合，可以通过 key 直接查找 value。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Map stores key-value pairs and lets you look up a value directly by its key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 操作耗时不随数据规模增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: O(1) means an operation's cost does not grow with the size of the input.

scenario: 车辆入场，系统要找兼容空位并发票。
q: 这段 enter 伪代码体现的状态变化顺序是什么？
codeSample:
enter(vehicleType)
    spot = findAvailableSpot(vehicleType)
    if spot == null throw NoSpace
    occupiedSpotIds.add(spot.id)
    ticket = Ticket(generateId(), spot.id, vehicleType, now())
    activeTickets[ticket.id] = ticket
    return ticket
options: 先创建 ticket，稍后再决定占不占车位
只更新 ParkingSpot.occupied，不碰 ticket
先占用 spotId，再创建并保存 ticket，最后返回 ticket
把车位分配推迟到出场时才做
why: 入场成功要同时建立车位占用索引和票据索引；找不到兼容空位时不能改变任何状态。
why_en: Entry claims a compatible spot, creates a ticket, stores it, and returns it, keeping both indexes in sync.
whenOtherWins: 多入口并发下，这段 find+add 必须放在同一把锁内，否则两辆车可能拿到同一个车位。
tradeoff: 先占位后发票保证不变量 vs 反过来可能留下幽灵占用
options_en: Create the ticket first and decide whether to claim a spot later.
Only update ParkingSpot.occupied, without touching the ticket.
Claim the spot ID first, then create and store the ticket, then return it.
Defer spot assignment until exit time.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A["vehicle arrives"] --> B["find spot"]
  B --> C["mark spot occupied"]
  C --> D["create ticket"]
  D --> E["store active ticket"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在任何时刻都必须保持成立的约束，例如 occupied 集合和 ticket 集合同步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An invariant is a condition the system must always keep true, such as keeping the occupied set and ticket map in sync.

scenario: 基础需求要求 exact compatible spot，不提『摩托可停汽车位』等 fallback。
q: findAvailableSpot 默认应如何查找空位？
options: 扫描 spots，找 spotType 匹配且不在 occupiedSpotIds 中的空位
任意空位都可以分配给任何车型，不检查 spotType 是否匹配
优先把停车场里最大的车位分配给所有车型，不管实际需要
按车辆到最近出口的实时距离做复杂路径排序后再分配
why: 基础规则是兼容类型精确匹配。没有需求提出 fallback 时不引入复杂分配策略。
why_en: The base allocation scans for an unoccupied spot with the required compatible type, nothing more.
whenOtherWins: 如果扩展允许 motorcycle 用 car spot，映射逻辑或分配策略需要支持 fallback 顺序。
tradeoff: 精确类型匹配的简单扫描 vs 提前引入的复杂分配策略
options_en: Scan spots for a matching spotType whose id is not in occupiedSpotIds.
Any free spot can be assigned to any vehicle type without checking spotType.
Always give the largest spot in the lot to every vehicle type.
Sort candidate spots by real-time distance to the nearest exit.

scenario: 用户出场提供 ticketId，ticket 存在且未使用过。
q: exit 的正确执行顺序是什么？
options: 出场时先把 activeTickets 里的 ticket 删除，再用它算 fee
查 ticket → 计算 fee → 释放 spot → 删除 active ticket → 返回 fee
只计算 fee 返回给用户，不释放 spot，占用状态一直保留
把该车位所在楼层的所有同类型车位全部释放，而不是只放这一个
why: 出场完成后车位可再次分配，ticket 不能再次使用；顺序必须保证 ticket 数据还在时先完成计费。
why_en: Exit looks up the ticket, computes the fee, frees the spot, removes the active ticket, and returns the fee, in that order.
whenOtherWins: 如果计费失败需要重试，删除 ticket 这一步应该放到计费和释放都确认成功之后再做。
tradeoff: 先读数据再清理状态 vs 先清理导致计费数据丢失
options_en: Delete the ticket from activeTickets first, then use it to compute the fee.
Look up the ticket, compute the fee, free the spot, remove the active ticket, then return the fee.
Only compute the fee without freeing the spot, leaving occupancy untouched.
Free every same-type spot on that floor, not just this one.
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant V as Vehicle
  participant L as ParkingLot
  participant T as Ticket
  V->>L: exit(ticketId)
  L->>T: load active ticket
  L->>L: calculate fee
  L->>L: free spot
  L->>L: remove active ticket

scenario: 用户可能重复使用同一张 ticket 出场。
q: 这段 exit 伪代码如何防止 double exit？
codeSample:
exit(ticketId)
    if ticketId == null || ticketId == '' throw InvalidTicket
    ticket = activeTickets[ticketId]
    if ticket == null throw InvalidTicket
    fee = computeFee(ticket.entryTime, now())
    occupiedSpotIds.remove(ticket.spotId)
    activeTickets.remove(ticketId)
    return fee
options: 在 Ticket 上增加 usedCount 字段计数
允许重复计费，只记录日志
成功出场后删除 activeTickets 项，下一次查不到同一 ticket
只删除 occupiedSpotIds，保留 ticket
why: activeTickets 是当前有效票据集合，移除后已使用票据和随机无效票据都表现为同一种 invalid。
why_en: Removing the ticket from activeTickets makes any repeated exit with the same ticket ID come back invalid.
whenOtherWins: 如果要区分『从未存在』和『已使用』这两种错误，需要额外维护 usedTickets 或历史记录。
tradeoff: 用集合成员资格表达有效性 vs 额外状态字段表达已用
options_en: Add a usedCount field on the Ticket to count exits.
Allow repeated billing and only log it.
Remove the entry from activeTickets on success, so the next lookup finds nothing.
Only remove occupiedSpotIds, keeping the ticket around.

scenario: 系统用 durationMillis 表示停车时长，按小时向上取整计费，hourlyRateCents=500。
q: computeFee 应该如何处理 2.5 小时这类不足整数小时的时长？
options: 把算出来的小数 durationHours 四舍五入到最近整数小时
durationMillis 对 3600000 取模，余数 > 0 就 hours+1，再乘费率
忽略不足一小时的余量，只按整除后的小时数收费
用浮点数 durationMillis/3600000.0 直接乘以小时费率
why: 需求是不足一小时也按一小时收费，只有『余数>0则hours+1』能保证任何非零余量都进位；四舍五入和向下取整都会算错 2.5 小时的场景。
why_en: The rule is that any partial hour still bills a full hour, so only the remainder-then-increment check gets a 2.5-hour stay right.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品要求首小时免费或按分钟计费，这段取整逻辑要整体替换。
tradeoff: 余数判断的整数取整 vs 四舍五入或浮点近似
options_en: Round the fractional durationHours to the nearest whole hour.
Take durationMillis modulo 3600000; if the remainder is greater than 0, add one hour before multiplying by the rate.
Ignore the partial-hour remainder and bill only the floored whole hours.
Multiply the raw floating-point durationMillis/3600000.0 by the hourly rate.
codeSample:
computeFee(entryMs, exitMs)
    durationMs = exitMs - entryMs
    hours = durationMs / 3600000
    if durationMs % 3600000 > 0
        hours = hours + 1
    return hours * hourlyRateCents

termDefinitions.meaning: 两数相除后的余数运算，用 % 表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Modulo is the remainder operation after division, written with the % operator.

q: ParkingLot 应处理哪些基础错误？（多选）
options: 无兼容空位时拒绝入场
ticketId 空或不存在时拒绝出场
已使用 ticket 再次出场时拒绝
金额用浮点数导致精度误差
why: 前三个是业务错误处理要求，最后一个是实现风险；金额用整数 cents 存储能避开浮点精度问题。
why_en: The design rejects full-lot entry, invalid or reused tickets, and uses integer money to avoid floating-point precision errors.
options_en: Reject entry when no compatible spot is available.
Reject exit when the ticket ID is empty or does not exist.
Reject exit when a used ticket is presented again.
Using floating-point money causes precision drift.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浮点数用二进制近似小数，反复运算会累积微小误差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Floating-point numbers approximate decimals in binary, so repeated arithmetic accumulates small errors.

scenario: VehicleType 和 SpotType 目前都只有 MOTORCYCLE/CAR/LARGE 三个值，取值完全相同。
q: 为什么 VehicleType 和 SpotType 即使值相同也要分成两个 enum？
options: 车辆类型和车位类型是不同概念，未来兼容关系可能变化
编程语言不允许两个类复用同一组常量
只是为了增加类的数量，方便面试展示
因为 Ticket 类型上不能存 VehicleType 字段
why: 分开建模让『摩托可停汽车位』这类兼容逻辑更清晰；相同标签不代表两者是同一个领域概念。
why_en: Vehicle type and spot type are different concepts even though their current labels match, which keeps future compatibility rules clean.
tradeoff: 语义分离换未来兼容逻辑的清晰 vs 合并 enum 省一个类型定义
options_en: Vehicle type and spot type are different concepts, and their compatibility rules may diverge later.
The programming language forbids two classes from reusing the same constants.
It is only done to add more classes for the interview to look impressive.
Because Ticket cannot store a VehicleType field.

scenario: ParkingSpot 在当前设计中只表示物理车位的固有属性，不参与占用或计费逻辑。
q: ParkingSpot 需要哪些字段？
options: occupied boolean、ticket map、hourlyRate
id 和 spotType
entryTime 和 fee
全部 activeTickets 的引用
why: ParkingSpot 是纯数据对象，只保存物理身份和兼容类型；占用和票据由 ParkingLot 管理。
why_en: ParkingSpot stores only intrinsic properties: its ID and spot type.
whenOtherWins: 如果选用实体自管物理占用的方案，可以在 ParkingSpot 上加 occupied/status 字段。
tradeoff: 只存内在属性的纯数据对象 vs 把关系状态也塞进实体
options_en: An occupied boolean, a ticket map, and an hourly rate.
id and spotType.
entryTime and fee.
A reference to every entry in activeTickets.

q: 按顺序排列一次停车会话的状态变化：
steps: findAvailableSpot 找到空车位 B。
occupiedSpotIds 加入 B。
创建 Ticket(T123,B,CAR,entryTime) 并放入 activeTickets。
exit(T123) 计算 fee。
occupiedSpotIds 删除 B，activeTickets 删除 T123。
why: 同一会话由 occupiedSpotIds 和 activeTickets 两个索引共同表达，出场必须同时清理两者。
why_en: A parking session claims a spot, stores a ticket, computes a fee on exit, and clears both indexes together.
tradeoff: 双索引同步表达一次会话 vs 单一来源每次动态推导
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Gate
  participant Lot
  participant Ticket
  Gate->>Lot: enter(CAR)
  Lot->>Lot: claim spot B
  Lot->>Ticket: create T123
  Gate->>Lot: exit(T123)
  Lot->>Lot: fee and release B

termDefinitions.meaning: 为了快速查找而额外维护的数据结构，需要和源数据保持同步。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An index is extra data maintained purely to make lookups fast, and it must stay in sync with the source data.

scenario: Ticket 已经发给用户，后续会用来计费和释放车位。
q: Ticket 字段应如何设计？
options: 允许用户修改 entryTime
让 ParkingSpot 反过来修改 ticketId
构造后只读，不暴露任何修改方法
每次出场前随机重写 spotId
why: Ticket 是会话记录，应稳定反映入场事实；不可变让计费和验证更可靠，避免被意外篡改。
why_en: Ticket should be immutable because it records the facts of the parking session and must stay reliable for billing and validation.
whenOtherWins: 如果未来要支持改签停车时段，才需要给 Ticket 加受控的状态转换方法，而不是暴露 setter。
tradeoff: 不可变记录保证计费可靠 vs 可变字段带来的一致性风险
options_en: Allow the user to modify entryTime.
Let ParkingSpot modify the ticketId in return.
Read-only after construction, with no exposed mutation methods.
Randomly rewrite spotId before every exit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对象创建后字段不能再被修改。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An immutable object cannot have its fields changed after it is created.

scenario: 后续要求 motorcycle 3 美元/小时，car 5 美元/小时，large 8 美元/小时。
q: 最简单合理的扩展方式是什么？
options: 立刻抽出 PricingStrategy 接口，为单一规则做多态扩展
让 Ticket 自己保存三档价格并在内部计算费用
为每个 SpotType 分别实例化一整个 ParkingLot 系统
ParkingLot 存 Map<VehicleType,rate>，computeFee 按车型查表
why: 只有按车型不同费率这一条规则时，一个 map 就足够简单；Strategy 模式留给更复杂、可动态替换的定价规则。
why_en: A map from vehicle type to hourly rate is enough for simple per-type pricing, without introducing a strategy interface.
whenOtherWins: 如果要支持动态定价、折扣、会员或节假日策略，PricingStrategy 才更合适。
tradeoff: 按车型查表的简单扩展 vs 提前上 Strategy 模式的过度设计
options_en: Introduce a PricingStrategy interface right away for a single rule.
Let the Ticket store all three price tiers and compute its own fee.
Instantiate a whole separate ParkingLot per SpotType.
ParkingLot stores a Map<VehicleType, rate> and computeFee looks it up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 键值对集合，这里键是 VehicleType，值是对应费率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Map<K,V> stores key-value pairs — here the key is a vehicle type and the value is its hourly rate.

scenario: 当前需求只有一条简单的『所有车型同一 hourly rate』定价规则，没有折扣或动态定价。
q: 为什么基础需求下不一开始就抽 PricingStrategy？
options: 只有一个简单 hourly rule，提前抽象违反 YAGNI
Strategy pattern 在任何场景下都不好用
Ticket 对象无法传给策略对象
费用计算逻辑不需要写测试
why: 抽象要为真实存在的变化付费；当前只有单一计费规则，直接在 ParkingLot.computeFee 里实现更直接。
why_en: A pricing strategy is premature when the only requirement is one simple hourly rule, which is exactly what YAGNI warns against.
tradeoff: 为当下唯一规则保持直接实现 vs 为假设的未来复杂度提前抽象
options_en: There is only one simple hourly rule, so abstracting early violates YAGNI.
The Strategy pattern is never useful in any scenario.
A Ticket object cannot be passed into a strategy object.
Fee-calculation logic does not need tests.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不要为还不存在的需求提前构建抽象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: YAGNI means you should not build abstraction for a requirement that does not exist yet.

scenario: 后续扩展为 10 层商场停车楼。
q: 最自然的新增实体是什么？
options: 把 floorNumber 塞进 hourlyRate 字段里编码
每层建一个独立系统，且不能共享 ticket
ParkingFloor：ParkingLot 持有 floors，Floor 持有 spots
直接删除 ParkingSpot，改用坐标数组
why: ParkingFloor 是 ParkingLot 和 ParkingSpot 之间自然的容器层，spotId 可以顺便携带楼层信息，如 3-A15。
why_en: A multi-floor garage introduces ParkingFloor as a container between ParkingLot and ParkingSpot.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需显示楼层而没有楼层级别的逻辑，也可以把 floorNumber 直接放在 ParkingSpot 上。
tradeoff: 新增中间层容器 vs 把楼层信息硬塞进不相关字段
options_en: Encode floorNumber inside the hourlyRate field.
Build an independent system per floor that cannot share tickets.
ParkingFloor: ParkingLot holds floors, and each floor holds spots.
Delete ParkingSpot entirely and use a coordinate array instead.

q: 多层扩展后可采用哪些车位分配策略？（多选）
options: 低楼层优先分配
按各层可用车位数量做均衡分配
按目的地或入口距离选择楼层
永远随机选择离入口最远的楼层
why: 不同策略优化不同体验：靠近出口、避免单层拥堵、或靠近目的地；复杂到一定程度可以抽 AllocationStrategy。
why_en: Multi-floor allocation can prioritize lower floors, balance capacity across floors, or optimize for destination proximity.
options_en: Fill lower floors first.
Balance allocation by the number of available spots per floor.
Choose a floor by destination or entrance proximity.
Always randomly pick the floor farthest from the entrance.

scenario: 多个入口同时调用 enter(CAR)，两个线程都看到同一个 spot 空闲。
q: 这是哪类问题，最简单的修复方式是什么？
options: 内存泄漏问题；重启服务进程就能解决
check-then-act race；同步整个 enter 关键区
浮点精度误差问题；把金额改成整数 cents
路径解析错误；改用 resolvePath 工具函数
why: findAvailableSpot 和 occupiedSpotIds.add 必须原子化。同步整个 enter 足够简单，且停车场入场吞吐通常远低于锁能处理的量级。
why_en: Concurrent entries can race between finding and claiming a spot, so the critical section should be synchronized as a whole.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有单一入口，本来就不存在并发，加锁没有必要。
tradeoff: 简单的方法级锁 vs 更细粒度但更复杂的并发方案
options_en: A memory leak; restarting the service process fixes it.
A check-then-act race; synchronize the whole enter critical section.
A floating-point precision bug; switch money to integer cents.
A path-parsing error; switch to a resolvePath utility function.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先检查条件再执行动作，中间如果被其他线程插入就会产生竞态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Check-then-act means checking a condition and then acting on it, which races if another thread intervenes in between.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次只能被一个线程执行的代码区域。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A critical section is a block of code that only one thread may execute at a time.

scenario: 实现多入口并发下的入场分配。
q: 这段 synchronized 锁的作用是什么？
codeSample:
enter(vehicleType)
    synchronized(this)
        spot = findAvailableSpot(vehicleType)
        if spot == null throw NoSpace
        occupiedSpotIds.add(spot.id)
        ticket = Ticket(generateId(), spot.id, vehicleType, now())
        activeTickets[ticket.id] = ticket
        return ticket
options: 只保护 fee 计算这一步
故意让两个入口拿到同一个 spot
替代 ticketId 的生成逻辑
把查找空位、占用和保存 ticket 做成一个原子操作
why: 锁住整个关键区能防止两个线程分配同一车位；这个粒度在停车场规模下通常足够。
why_en: The lock makes spot search, claim, and ticket creation atomic across entrances, preventing two threads from claiming the same spot.
whenOtherWins: 如果持久化到数据库，应改用事务和唯一约束，或 SELECT FOR UPDATE，而不是内存锁。
tradeoff: 粗粒度互斥保证正确 vs 更高并发但更复杂的方案
options_en: It only protects the fee-calculation step.
It deliberately lets two entrances claim the same spot.
It replaces ticket ID generation logic.
It makes spot search, claim, and ticket save one atomic operation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 要么完整执行，要么完全不执行，不会被其他线程看到中间状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic operation either completes fully or not at all, with no other thread able to observe a partial result.

termDefinitions.meaning: 互斥锁，同一时刻只允许一个线程进入被保护的代码块。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A mutex lock allows only one thread at a time to enter the protected section of code.

scenario: 想让多个入口并发搜索空位，只在真正占用车位时短暂互斥。
q: 支持并发搜索、只在占用时短暂独占的更细粒度方案是什么？
options: 读锁搜索，写锁内 double-check 后占用，冲突则重试
完全不加任何锁，读写都自由进行
只锁 activeTickets，不锁 occupiedSpotIds
给每个 ticket 单独分配一把锁
why: 读写锁允许多个搜索并行，但 read 和 write 之间可能被别的线程抢先，所以写锁内要二次检查后再占用。
why_en: A read-write approach searches concurrently, then double-checks and claims the spot under the write lock, retrying on conflict.
whenOtherWins: 对 3-5 个入口的普通停车场，方法级互斥更简单，性能也已经足够。
tradeoff: 读写锁提高并发但要 double-check vs 单一互斥锁简单但完全串行
options_en: Search under a read lock, then double-check and claim under a write lock, retrying on conflict.
Use no locking at all for reads or writes.
Lock only activeTickets and leave occupiedSpotIds unlocked.
Give every ticket its own separate lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 允许多个读操作并发进行，但写操作需要独占访问的锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read-write lock lets multiple readers run concurrently but gives a writer exclusive access.

q: 按顺序排列多入口 race 的发生过程：
steps: 入口 A 和 B 同时调用 findAvailableSpot。
二者都看到 spot B 不在 occupiedSpotIds 里。
A 创建 ticket 指向 spot B。
B 也创建 ticket 指向 spot B。
两辆车拿到了同一个车位。
why: 问题窗口在『检查空闲』和『写入占用』之间；必须把两步合并成同一个临界区才能消除这个 race。
why_en: The race occurs because two entrances observe the same free spot before either one claims it, so the check and the claim must become one critical section.
tradeoff: 分离的检查与占用步骤 vs 合并成一个原子临界区
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as Gate A
  participant S as spot B
  participant B as Gate B
  A->>S: sees free
  B->>S: sees free
  A->>S: claim
  B->>S: claim

termDefinitions.meaning: 多线程同时读写共享状态导致结果依赖执行顺序的错误。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A race condition happens when concurrent threads read and write shared state and the outcome depends on timing.

scenario: 停车场有 3-5 个入口，单次 enter 处理约 100 毫秒；200 个车位平均每 2 小时周转一次。
q: 为什么同步整个 enter() 方法在现实停车场规模下通常足够？
options: 因为加锁本身会让车位的物理数量凭空增加
因为这类题目里假设停车场永远只有一个车位
因为 ticket map 的按 ID 查找本身非常慢
入场频率远低于锁可处理的吞吐，车通过闸机/支付耗时远大于内存操作
why: 工程取舍要看数量级：停车场的真实入场频率很低，简单正确的方案应该优先于过早优化。
why_en: A coarse enter lock is usually fine because parking-lot arrival rates are tiny compared with in-memory critical-section throughput.
tradeoff: 按数量级判断是否需要优化 vs 不看数量级就上复杂并发方案
options_en: Because locking itself somehow makes the physical spot count grow.
Because this kind of problem always assumes only one spot exists.
Because ticket-map lookup by ID is itself extremely slow.
Arrival frequency is far below what the lock can handle, since gate and payment time dwarf in-memory work.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单位时间内系统能处理的请求数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Throughput is the number of requests a system can process per unit of time.

scenario: 有人说 Node.js 单线程就完全不会有 race condition。
q: 面对这个说法应该如何回应？
options: 单线程模型下永远不会出现逻辑上的 race
异步 await 之间仍可能交错，持久化时要靠数据库事务或分布式锁保证原子性
Node.js 本身就不适合实现停车场系统
只要用 Set 存状态就自动获得事务保证
why: 单线程事件循环避免了同一时刻执行两段 JS，但异步 I/O 会在 await 点把请求流程切开，数据库层仍要保证 check-and-claim 原子。
why_en: Single-threaded event loops can still interleave async workflows at await points, so persistence still needs transactional protection.
whenOtherWins: 如果所有状态更新都在同一个不跨越 await 的同步代码块里，才真的不需要额外加锁。
tradeoff: 单线程避免同一时刻双执行 vs 异步交错仍需事务或分布式锁
options_en: A single-threaded model can never have a logical race.
Async await points can still interleave, so persistence needs database transactions or a distributed lock.
Node.js is simply unsuited for building a parking-lot system.
Storing state in a Set automatically gives you transaction guarantees.

termDefinitions.meaning: Node.js 单线程调度模型，在 I/O 等待点切换执行其他任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The event loop is Node.js's single-threaded scheduler that switches to other work while one task waits on I/O.

termDefinitions.meaning: 跨多个进程或服务器协调、只允许一个持有者继续执行的锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distributed lock coordinates across multiple processes or servers so only one holder can proceed at a time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库锁定被查询的行，防止其他事务并发修改它们。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SELECT FOR UPDATE locks the selected database rows so no other transaction can modify them concurrently.

scenario: ticketId 从未存在过，或者已经出场使用过一次。
q: 基础 exit 应该对这两种情况返回什么语义？
options: 必须区分成两个不同的复杂错误码
自动为用户重新发一张新 ticket
两种情况统一视为 invalid ticket
照常释放一个任意车位再报错
why: activeTickets 只表示当前有效票据集合，不存在和已使用对出场流程都是不可用，没必要区分。
why_en: A ticket not present in activeTickets is invalid whether it never existed or was already used, so exit treats them the same.
whenOtherWins: 如果客服或审计需要区分这两种情况，可以额外保存历史 used tickets 和状态。
tradeoff: 统一 invalid 语义换实现简单 vs 区分两种错误换更精确反馈
options_en: The two cases must be distinguished with two different complex error codes.
Automatically issue the user a brand-new ticket.
Treat both cases uniformly as an invalid ticket.
Free some arbitrary spot anyway before reporting an error.

scenario: 后续要支持车位维修或临时封闭。
q: 在当前占用建模（occupiedSpotIds Set）下，新增维修状态最自然放在哪里？
options: ParkingSpot 加 status 字段，或 ParkingLot 加 disabledSpotIds 过滤
在 Ticket 记录上增加一个记录维修人员姓名和联系方式的字段
往 VehicleType 这个车辆分类 enum 里新增一个 BROKEN 取值
把这个车位的 hourlyRate 计费字段直接改成 0 表示不可用
why: 维修是车位自身或可用性约束，不是 ticket 会话的一部分；基础设计没有实现，但可以沿分配过滤自然扩展。
why_en: Maintenance can be modeled as spot status or a disabled-spot-ID set that allocation simply skips.
whenOtherWins: 如果车位物理状态很多，ParkingSpot.status enum 更适合；只是临时屏蔽少数车位，用 disabled set 更轻量。
tradeoff: 维护性状态放进车位可用性过滤 vs 混进车辆分类或计价字段
options_en: Add a status field to ParkingSpot, or a disabledSpotIds filter on ParkingLot.
Add a field on the Ticket record storing the maintenance worker's name and contact info.
Add a new BROKEN value into the VehicleType vehicle-classification enum.
Change that spot's hourlyRate billing field directly to zero to mark it unusable.

scenario: 监控或前端目前都没有提出『查询实时车位状态』的需求。
q: 为什么基础 API 不主动加 getAvailableSpots 或 getParkingStatus？
options: 这两个方法在技术上根本无法实现
需求没有要求，暴露内部状态会扩大 API；监控需求来了再加
加了这两个方法会破坏 ticketId 的唯一性
使用者必须提前知道全部车位信息
why: 接口应该围绕核心工作流最小化；过早暴露内部集合会增加耦合，等真正的监控需求出现再加不迟。
why_en: The base API stays focused on entry and exit until status queries are explicitly required, to avoid premature coupling.
tradeoff: 接口按需最小化 vs 提前暴露内部状态换『可能有用』
options_en: These two methods are technically impossible to implement.
There is no requirement for them, and exposing internal state widens the API; add them when monitoring is actually needed.
Adding them would break the uniqueness of ticketId.
Callers must already know the full spot inventory in advance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只暴露必要的公开接口，隐藏内部实现细节。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Encapsulation means exposing only the necessary public interface while hiding internal implementation details.

q: 出场计费的正确执行顺序是什么？
steps: 从 activeTickets 取出 ticket。
计算 exitTime - entryTime。
按小时向上取整。
乘以 hourlyRateCents。
释放 spot 并删除 ticket。
why: 必须先有 ticket 才能知道 entryTime 和 spotId；删除 ticket 前要先取够计费和释放所需的数据。
why_en: Exit fee calculation uses the active ticket's entry time, rounds duration up, multiplies by the rate, and only then clears state.
tradeoff: 先读后清理保证数据完整 vs 先清理导致计费数据丢失

scenario: 所有 car spotId 都已经在 occupiedSpotIds 中，此时来了一辆车，车辆类型为 CAR。
q: enter(CAR) 应该如何处理？
options: 发一张 ticket，但 spotId 留空
拒绝入场，且不创建 ticket
临时占用一个 motorcycle spot
把最早入场的旧 ticket 强制删除
why: 没有兼容空位时不能创建停车会话；创建一张没有 spot 的 ticket 会破坏 exit 释放逻辑的不变量。
why_en: Entry must fail without creating a ticket when no compatible spot is available.
whenOtherWins: 如果支持候补排队，可以创建一个 WaitingRequest，但那不是基础 ticket 流程。
tradeoff: 无空位时拒绝并保持状态不变 vs 创建残缺 ticket 破坏不变量
options_en: Issue a ticket but leave spotId empty.
Reject entry and create no ticket at all.
Temporarily occupy a motorcycle spot instead.
Force-remove the oldest active ticket to make room.

scenario: 多层停车楼希望根据不同目标（靠近出口/均衡/靠近目的地）选择不同分配策略。
q: 何时应该引入 AllocationStrategy？
options: 单层 exact-match 场景一开始就必须引入
当 Ticket 没有 entryTime 字段时
当金额改用 cents 存储时
当分配规则会在低楼层优先、均衡、目的地接近等策略间切换时
why: Strategy 模式适合真实存在、可能被替换的算法；基础单一规则下直接实现更简洁。
why_en: AllocationStrategy earns its complexity when spot-selection policy genuinely varies and needs to be swapped.
whenOtherWins: 如果只有单层、单一规则，不必引入 Strategy，直接 inline 实现更清楚。
tradeoff: 真实可替换算法才上 Strategy vs 单一规则直接内联实现
options_en: The single-floor exact-match case must introduce it right away.
When the Ticket has no entryTime field.
When money switches to storing cents.
When allocation policy genuinely switches among lowest-floor-first, balanced, and destination-proximity strategies.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A["one simple allocation rule"] --> B["inline method"]
  C["multiple changing policies"] --> D["AllocationStrategy"]
  D --> E["nearest, cheapest, level aware"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把可替换的算法封装成独立类，运行时可以互换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Strategy pattern encapsulates interchangeable algorithms as separate classes that can be swapped at runtime.

q: 补全三类对象的职责：
text: ParkingLot 管 {{分配、activeTickets、occupiedSpotIds、计费}}；ParkingSpot 管 {{id 和 spotType}}；Ticket 管 {{ticketId、spotId、vehicleType、entryTime}}。
why: 职责边界清晰后，入场和出场流程都变成 orchestrator 对简单记录和物理资源的协调。
why_en: ParkingLot owns workflows and indexes, ParkingSpot owns intrinsic spot properties, and Ticket records a session.

q: Senior 级 Parking Lot 回答应主动覆盖哪些技术要点？（多选）
options: Vehicle 不建实体的理由
occupied flag / derived / Set 三种方案的权衡
Ticket 用 map 按 ID 查找的理由
金额用整数 cents 存储
多入口并发 race 的成因和加锁方案
why: 高级答案要能主动解释状态归属、数据结构选择和并发正确性，而不仅仅是列出类图。
why_en: Senior answers explain entity pruning, occupancy tradeoffs, ticket lookup, integer money, and multi-entrance races without being prompted.
options_en: Why Vehicle is not modeled as an entity.
The tradeoffs among flag, derived, and Set approaches to occupancy.
Why Ticket lookup uses a map keyed by ID.
Storing money as integer cents.
The cause of multi-entrance races and how to lock against them.

q: 按顺序排列 Parking Lot 的主设计链路：
steps: ParkingLot 作为入口，持有 spots、occupiedSpotIds、activeTickets、hourlyRateCents。
澄清三类车、自动兼容分配、ticket、出场计费和释放。
Vehicle 降级为 enum，Ticket 建成不可变会话记录。
占用建模为 ParkingLot 维护的关系索引 Set。
enter/exit 分别原子维护 ticket 和 occupied spot 状态。
why: 从范围澄清到实体裁剪，再到状态归属和流程不变量，是这道题的主要论证路径。
why_en: The design chain moves from scoped requirements to entity pruning, orchestrator state, occupancy indexing, and lifecycle updates.
tradeoff: 范围裁剪先行再定状态归属 vs 一上来就画类图

scenario: 系统需要同时用 occupiedSpotIds 和 activeTickets 两个索引描述同一次停车会话，两者必须保持同步。
q: 面试收尾时，哪一句最准确地总结这个不变量？
options: 系统里每一辆进出过的车，都必须对应一个持久化保存状态的 Vehicle 实体类
active ticket 指向的 spotId 必须在 occupiedSpotIds 中；成功 exit 后二者都要被删除
所有车位的编号命名必须在整个停车场范围内按楼层严格连续排序
所有发出的 ticket 只要生成成功就永久有效，理论上永远不会失效或过期
why: ParkingLot 用两个索引表达同一会话；入场同时创建两者，出场同时清理两者，才能避免重复出场或重复分配。
why_en: The key invariant is that active tickets and occupied spot IDs stay in sync for every parking session.
whenOtherWins: 如果从 activeTickets 推导 occupancy，就不需要维护 Set，但分配时要保护对 tickets 的读取和修改。
tradeoff: 双索引同步的不变量 vs 单一来源但需要每次重新推导
options_en: Every vehicle that has ever entered must have a persisted, stateful Vehicle entity class.
The spotId an active ticket points to must be in occupiedSpotIds, and a successful exit removes both.
Spot numbers must be strictly and continuously sorted by floor across the entire lot.
Every issued ticket stays valid forever once created, theoretically never expiring or timing out.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在任何时刻都必须保持成立的约束。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An invariant is a condition the system must always keep true.

scenario: 面试官按中级候选人的标准评估这道 Parking Lot 设计。
q: 中级候选人在本题应能稳定说明什么？
options: 必须一次性实现多层楼分配策略并处理跨楼层并发锁
必须使用数据库事务和 SELECT FOR UPDATE 来保证一致性
必须把 Vehicle 建成完整类并存车主、车牌信息
ParkingLot 编排、ParkingSpot 存属性、Ticket 是记录，能处理三类边界情况
why: 中级重点是职责清晰和关键边界情况；多层策略和并发多入口是高级候选人再深入的部分。
why_en: A mid-level answer should clearly separate ParkingLot, ParkingSpot, and Ticket and handle the key entry and exit edge cases.
tradeoff: 中级看职责分离与边界情况 vs 高级才要求的并发/多层深挖
options_en: Implement multi-floor allocation and cross-floor concurrency locking in one pass.
Use database transactions and SELECT FOR UPDATE to guarantee consistency.
Build Vehicle as a full class storing owner and license-plate information.
ParkingLot orchestrates, ParkingSpot stores properties, Ticket is a record, and it handles the three key edge cases.

scenario: entryTime 和 exitTime 相同，车辆几乎立刻出场。
q: 按『hourly rounded up』规则，durationMillis 为 0 时应如何思考？
options: 永远收 0，不追问产品是否需要设定最低消费门槛
永远收 24 小时，把这种情况当成整天处理
是否收 0 或 1 小时要先向产品澄清；非零但不足一小时仍向上收 1 小时
认为这种边界情况在数学上根本无法算出费用
why: 计费规则强调部分小时向上取整，但 0 分钟是否有最低收费属于产品语义，面试中应该主动澄清或明确定义，而不是自己假设。
why_en: Partial hours clearly round up, but the exact zero-duration minimum charge is a product rule that should be clarified rather than assumed.
whenOtherWins: 如果业务明确规定最低一小时收费，那么 duration 为 0 时也直接返回一小时的费用。
tradeoff: 边界语义需要产品澄清 vs 默认套用向上取整规则
options_en: Always charge 0 without asking product whether a minimum charge applies.
Always charge 24 hours, treating this edge case as a full day.
Clarify with product whether 0 or 1 hour applies; any nonzero partial hour still rounds up to 1.
Claim this edge case is mathematically impossible to bill at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无论实际使用多短，至少收取的费用下限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A minimum charge is the smallest fee charged regardless of how briefly the resource was used.
